## BoxPlot
# load dataset
```{r}
library(devtools)
library(QuantPsyc)
library(psych)
library(extrafont)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(ggpubr)
library(ggsignif)
library(rstatix) 
library(ggbreak) 
```

```{r load-data}
# Read Data
d1 <- read.csv('Data_Task_Acc_RT_Boxplot.csv')
# stats
stat.test <- d1 %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  t_test(Accuracy ~ Group, paired = FALSE, var.equal = FALSE) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj") %>%
# view results
print(stat.test)

#reorder
d1$Group=factor(d1$Group,levels = c("DLD","TYP"), ordered=TRUE)

# Relabel (replace existing_level1/existing_level2 with what you see above)
d1$Condition <- factor(d1$Condition,
                       levels = c("Phon", "Sem"),
                       labels = c("Sound", "Meaning"))

# Create the plot and change color of bars - Accuracy
p <- ggplot(d1, aes(x = Condition, y = Accuracy, fill = Group)) +
     theme_bw(base_size = 20)+
     scale_fill_manual(values=c("WHITE","GREY"), name = "Group", labels = c("DLD", "TYP")) +
# Outliers
  geom_boxplot(outlier.shape = NA)+
  geom_point(position = position_jitterdodge(), alpha=0.3)+
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )+
# Plot the sig manually
  #geom_signif(y_position = c(101.5,101.5, 105.5), xmin = c(0.8,1.8,0.8), 
  #            xmax = c(1.2,2.2, 1.8), annotation = c("**","*", "*"),textsize = 10, vjust = 0.55,
  #            tip_length = 0)+
# Limits y axis
  ylim(25,100)
# labels
p <- p + labs(
              x = "", 
              y = "% Accuracy"
              ) 
p + theme(plot.title = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold"),
axis.title.x = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold"),
axis.title.y = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold"),
axis.text.y.left = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold"),
axis.text.x.bottom = element_text(color="black", size=20, face="bold")
)
```

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(rstatix)

# Read data
d1 <- read.csv("Data_Task_Acc_RT_Boxplot.csv")

# Reorder and relabel factors
d1$Group <- factor(
  d1$Group,
  levels = c("DLD", "TYP"),
  ordered = TRUE
)

d1$Condition <- factor(
  d1$Condition,
  levels = c("Phon", "Sem"),
  labels = c("Sound", "Meaning")
)

# Statistical tests
stat.test <- d1 %>%
  group_by(Condition) %>%
  t_test(
    Accuracy ~ Group,
    paired = FALSE,
    var.equal = FALSE
  ) %>%
  adjust_pvalue(method = "bonferroni") %>%
  add_significance("p.adj")

print(stat.test)

# Calculate means and standard errors
plot_data <- d1 %>%
  group_by(Condition, Group) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_Accuracy = mean(Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE),
    SE = sd(Accuracy, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(Accuracy))),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

# Create bar plot
p <- ggplot(
  plot_data,
  aes(
    x = Condition,
    y = Mean_Accuracy,
    fill = Group
  )
) +
  geom_col(
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.7,
    colour = "black"
  ) +
  geom_errorbar(
    aes(
      ymin = Mean_Accuracy - SE,
      ymax = Mean_Accuracy + SE
    ),
    position = position_dodge(width = 0.8),
    width = 0.2,
    linewidth = 0.8
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "DLD" = "#66c2a5",
      "TYP" = "#fc8d62"
    ),
    name = "Group"
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))
  ) +
  labs(
    x = "Task",
    y = "Task performance (%)"
  ) +
  theme_bw(base_size = 20) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    legend.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.title.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(
      color = "black",
      size = 20,
      face = "bold"
    )
  )

p
```
